description.zh:
要取消升级的设备名称。

设备名称不能重复。

最多可传入200个设备名称。
description.en:
The names of the devices whose upgrades you want to cancel.

Device names must be unique.

You can specify up to 200 device names.

description.zh:
OTA升级包ID，OTA升级包的唯一标识符。

OTA升级包ID是调用[CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~)创建OTA升级包时，返回的参数之一。

可以调用[ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~)，从返回参数中查看。
description.en:
The unique ID of the OTA update package.

An update package ID is returned after you call the [CreateOTAFirmware](~~147311~~) operation to create the update package.

You can call the [ListOTAFirmware](~~147450~~) operation and view the update package ID in the response.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
>*   If no **Overview** page or ID is generated for your instance, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
升级批次ID。传入此参数则只取消指定批次下的设备升级任务。
批次ID是您调用[CreateOTAVerifyJob](~~147480~~)、[CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~)或[CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~)创建升级任务后返回的**JobId**。您也可以在物联网平台控制台上固件的**固件详情**页查看。
description.en:
The ID of the update batch. If you configure this parameter, only the device update tasks in the specified update batch are deleted.

After you call the [CreateOTAVerifyJob](~~147480~~), [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob](~~147496~~), or [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob](~~147887~~) operation to create a device update task, you can obtain the value of the **JobId** parameter. You can also view the batch ID on the **Firmware Details** page in the IoT Platform console.

description.zh: 要取消升级的设备所属产品的ProductKey。
description.en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.

title.zh: 取消待升级设备升级作业
title.en: Cancel Upgrade Jobs for Devices Pending Upgrade

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
该接口只能取消待推送、已推送、升级中状态的设备升级。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
This API can be used only to cancel device upgrades that are in the pending push, pushed, or upgrading status.

## QPS Limit
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send up to 10 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.
 > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot cancel-ota-task-by-device --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --firmware-id T0F5b5tpFnHQrgfk0000030100 --product-key a1V4kde0000 --job-id wahVIzGkCMuAUE2gDERM020000 --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot CancelOTATaskByDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --FirmwareId T0F5b5tpFnHQrgfk0000030100 --DeviceName.1 'example-string' --ProductKey a1V4kde0000 --JobId wahVIzGkCMuAUE2gDERM020000
